MAJOR_FINDING_PUBLISHING_EQUALS_POSITION.CONCLUSION: Gumroad places the most recently published product at POSITION 1 of the storefront automatically. No API call, no dashboard action, no spend.
MAJOR_FINDING_PUBLISHING_EQUALS_POSITION.THIS_CORRECTS_CYCLE_122: cycle 122 concluded 'storefront curation has no public API surface, therefore the flagship cannot be featured'. That was half-true and led to the wrong conclusion. It is true that no field controls curation. It is false that curation is unreachable: publishing a new product PUTS IT AT THE TOP of the storefront on its own.
MAJOR_FINDING_PUBLISHING_EQUALS_POSITION.why_it_matters_commercially: this is real, free, automatic distribution on the marketplace that already hosts the products, and it is awarded for the act of publishing. It also means the storefront rotates: owtmpe at position 3 is the product that can no longer charge $150, so its continued visibility is harmless, and the newest real product is what visitors see first.
MAJOR_FINDING_PUBLISHING_EQUALS_POSITION.implication_for_strategy: shipping sharp new products is not only inventory - it is a distribution event. This is the mechanism the previous ten cycles said did not exist.
